meta.title: Cloning an event whose live round had a line deleted should not fail
gaps: The setup recipe provides one line item, not three.
A line cannot be deleted while the round is live with the available operations.
The invited vendor cannot be hidden with the available operations.
The clone read-back cannot verify that the deleted line is not skipped or that nil.id is handled.

words.preconditions: A fresh RFQ event, published, with one QA vendor invited; bidding open for about 20 minutes.
steps: As the buyer, read the event and check that Status check: the reply's status code is a success (2xx — the request worked).
words.expected: The app answers cleanly — accepted or refused — but never with a server error. Read back afterwards: Status check: the reply's status code is a success (2xx — the request worked).
